claims.statement: The root Makefile orchestrates the monorepo: server-serve/server-serve-2 run the Go server on 8080/8081, e2e-test kills ports and spawns two servers before running the test suite, test-all runs server-test + e2e-test in parallel, and proto-gen runs api-linter then regenerates both TypeScript and Go protobuf.

The Zero Factory precommit gate runs three deterministic phases: format (gofmt -s -w on server, npm run fix on client), build (go build ./... && go vet ./... then npm run tsc), and test (go test -count=1 ./... on server); the Playwright E2E suite is skipped because it is infra-dependent.

The E2E test/ suite is driven via `cd test && npm test`, whose pretest step runs build:harness and build-unit-harness to produce test/dist/harness.js and test/dist/unit-harness.js via esbuild; invoking npx playwright test directly makes the specs fail with ENOENT on their missing harness bundles.
The Playwright config runs serially (fullyParallel: false) with a 10s timeout on Google Chrome only, and under CI=1 sets workers to 1 and retries to 2.

The precommit script is self-sufficient: if client/node_modules is absent it installs on demand via npm ci (fallback npm install), and it uses plain go test rather than go test -race because the race detector is unusable on the ARM host.

Protobuf changes are made only in proto/zerohub/v1/*.proto and regenerated with make proto-gen, which wipes the generated client/src/proto and server/pkg/proto dirs and invokes protoc with protoc-gen-ts_proto and protoc-gen-go in a single pass.
